content.comment_body: Currently, I'm unsure which type of microSD card is required for use with [product_name] [version_no], specifically with the L1 data register. I've tried several microSD cards, but always encounter an error message.

I've used microSD cards from various brands with different speed classes and sizes. The card should have a maximum size of 32 GB. If it exceeds 32 GB, you need to create a FAT32 partition of up to 32 GB. The card must be fully formatted using FAT32, not a quick format.
